title: Exzeo Announces New Stock Repurchase Program
summary: Exzeo Group Inc. (NYSE: XZO) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new program and adopted a corresponding plan under Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, to purchase up to $12 million of the company’s common shares, subject to market conditions. The authorization and plan are effective immediately. “This share repurchase program reflects our confidence in the long-term value of Exzeo Group.
